# Synthetic fixture data

Every CSV in this directory is fictional automated-test data. `SYNTH-*` identifiers and fictional names do not describe real sensors or refuges and must never be loaded into production.

The fixtures intentionally include valid, duplicate, malformed, missing-foreign-key, invalid-range, empty, and header-only cases. Real DS deliverables belong in ignored `data/processed/` paths and are never required by CI.
